content.title: Alpha and Omega: Fiscal Q4 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: SUNNYVALE, Calif. (AP) — Alpha and Omega Semiconductor Ltd. (AOSL) on Wednesday reported a loss of $77.1 million in its fiscal fourth quarter.  On a per-share basis, the Sunnyvale, California-based company said it had a loss of $2.58.  For the current quarter ending in September, Alpha and Omega said it expects revenue in the range of $173 million to $193 million.
